import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

When('the step invokes the real CLI', function () {
  if (process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT === '1') {
    const execution = spawnSync(process.execPath, [process.env.BDD_CORPUS_CLI!, '--help'], {
      encoding: 'utf8', env: process.env,
    });
    this.evidence = {
      environment: 'ambient', evidenceClass: 'unclassified', requestedHostScope: 'all',
      status: execution.status,
    };
    return;
  }
  this.evidencePromise = import(process.env.BDD_CORPUS_FIXTURE_RUNNER!).then(
    ({ runApprovedCliFixture }) => runApprovedCliFixture(
      process.env.BDD_CORPUS_CLI!,
      'claude',
      { ...process.env, SAFEWORD_UNRELATED_PLUGIN: 'codex' },
    ),
  );
});
Then('the result is sanitized runner-envelope evidence', async function () {
  if (this.evidencePromise) this.evidence = await this.evidencePromise;
  assert.equal(this.evidence.status, 0);
  assert.deepEqual(this.evidence, {
    environment: 'sanitized', requestedHostScope: 'claude', evidenceClass: 'fixture',
    unrelatedPluginVisible: false, status: 0,
  });
});
